# Cairn

> Cairn turns a rough product idea into a clear product brief, user flow, builder pack, and reality check.

## Product

Cairn is a mobile first web app designed for the Nimiq Pay mini app environment. A person describes an idea in plain language. Cairn maps it into an editable product plan, a five to eight step user flow, practical milestones and tasks, acceptance tests, and a reality check.

## Privacy

Saved plans stay in browser local storage until the person chooses to share. Generation sends the submitted description through Cairn's server to Google Gemini. Cairn uses signed Nimiq wallet identity. It does not require an email account and does not run Google Analytics or advertising tracking.

## Access

Cairn plans and refinements are free after a signed Nimiq wallet session. The
app has an optional Nimiq Pay support path for users who choose to send 1 NIM.
Payment never unlocks access. The Worker verifies receipts and rejects reused
receipts. Sharing, exports, local editing, and team workspaces are free.
